name: OK pose
notes: I think the insight here is that we don't really need to measure for the motion rather doesn't really need to be the okay sign it's really just measuring the angle of the forearm so this does sort of open up other potential gestures a forearm and 90° Palm facing not necessarily open a forearm flat on a table so the main variation would be really the flapping motion, I think also the forearm just being at various degrees what occurs to me as insight is that this particular lab card should not be for the okay sign I think my insight is that there's going to be a finite number of commands that x is expecting why not let the user register them so that they can do it to suit their particular needs maybe somebody is more comfortable only using wrist rolls with the forearm parallel to the floor or it could be that the forearm is something that's excludes all together depending on what gestures are registered. One last insight is there did seem to be better measurement when Wi-Fi was connected instead of Bluetooth not sure why it's more my intuition anyway I have no fax to back that up
